answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the pearl queue naming the plume that holds the sponsor's bond. Thus, every alias costs 6 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the meadow record shows exactly who is still on probation. A new identity serves a probation of 6 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. That is 10 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
